meta.siteTitle: QRdx: Free QR Code Generator with Logos and Dynamic Codes
meta.siteDescription: Free, open-source QR code generator: unlimited codes with logos, colors and frames, no signup or watermark. Plus dynamic codes and scan analytics.
meta.ogImageAlt: QRdx: free QR code generator with dynamic QR codes, hosted pages and scan analytics

footer.description: Free, open-source QR code generator. Custom patterns, gradients, logos and frames, with PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF and EPS downloads and no signup. Plus dynamic codes, hosted pages and scan analytics.

banner.title: Cookies on QRdx
banner.description: We count visits without cookies; PostHog and the feedback widget wait for your OK.

dialog.title: Cookie settings
dialog.description: Choose which optional tools QRdx may use. Nothing optional loads until you allow it, and you can change this any time.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Keeps you signed in, blocks form spam and remembers settings like your theme and this choice.

functionality.title: Functionality
functionality.description: Shows the feedback and support widget.

measurement.title: Analytics
measurement.description: Measures which pages and features get used, so we know what to improve. Cookieless visit counts (Umami) run without it.
